facts.F30: Formal verification: not applicable. No production code, state, transition, protocol or concurrency changes; the change is test structure only. The only laws are already unit-tested rules the rows pin and the id-preservation rule, a finite set equality checked by comparing id lists. Quint, TLA+/TLC and Agda would model nothing new, so no model is written and no checker run or claimed. Liveness is not applicable: no progress or temporal property exists in a synchronous test move. Property-based testing not applicable: no broad input domain; every law is a finite enumeration of named rows, ids and planted cases.
